note: Typical published fees as of September 2026. Card fees depend on your plan and the country your account is registered in; exchange-counter spreads vary by location and day. Reference mid-market rates are editable in the tool and only affect the yen figures, not the percentage comparison.

methods.name: Wise card
methods.desc: Mid-market rate plus a small transparent conversion fee (varies by currency).

methods.name: Revolut (Standard plan)
methods.desc: Interbank rate with no fee on weekdays up to your plan's monthly allowance; ~1% above it and a ~1% weekend markup.

methods.name: Typical bank credit / debit card
methods.desc: Visa/Mastercard network rate (close to mid-market) plus a ~3% foreign transaction fee.

methods.name: Japan ATM with a typical home-bank card
methods.desc: 7-Eleven / Japan Post ATM: ~3% foreign fee + your bank's flat withdrawal fee + the machine's ¥220 fee.

methods.name: City exchange bureau (Tokyo / Osaka)
methods.desc: Competitive street bureaux (e.g. around Shinjuku, Ginza, Namba) — spread of roughly 2–3% built into the rate.

methods.name: Airport exchange counter
methods.desc: Narita / Haneda / KIX counters — convenience priced in with a 5–7% spread.
